sources.title: Wikipedia: Spartacus
sources.description: Thracian gladiator who led a slave revolt

notes.text: Spartacus was a Thracian gladiator who was one of the escaped slave leaders in the Third Servile War, a major slave uprising against the Roman Republic.
Spartacus is remembered as a military personnel connected with Greece.
Spartacus's recorded life dates place this profile around -109--71.
Spartacus is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
Spartacus's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Greece historical setting.
